label: Frozen custard
note: Ice-cream mix with egg yolks (US standard: at least 1.4 %)

about.text: Frozen custard is a frozen dessert that is a type of ice cream made with egg yolks in addition to cream and sweetener, and an additional flavoring such as cocoa, vanilla, or fruit such as strawberries or peaches. It is usually kept at a warmer temperature compared to ice cream, and typically has a denser and thicker consistency.

how.text: Made in a continuous freezer: the mix flows through a refrigerated barrel where blades scrape off the frozen layer, and it is drawn straight into the container. Fast passage keeps air low and ice crystals small; the air is worked in by agitation, not added as an ingredient. The yolk gives a denser, richer body.
